<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "CDATA">
  <!ENTITY base "Parsed Entity Value">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
  <!-- Detailed comment preceding internal subset expansions -->
]>
<root xmlns:x="http://example.org/ns1" xmlns:y="http://example.org/ns2" x:id="123">
  <?target data instructions for processing nodes?>
  <!-- Another comment inside the element tree -->
  <![CDATA[
    CDATA section containing markup-like strings: <node attr="val">&base;</node>
  ]]>
  <y:child>Text and &base;</y:child>
</root>

<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (#PCDATA | sub)*>
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>">
  <!ENTITY general "General Entity &nested;">
  <!ENTITY nested "Nested Entity">
  <?target-pi processing instruction payload?>
]>
<doc xmlns="http://default.ns.uri" xmlns:custom="http://custom.ns.uri">
  <!-- Comment wrapping around complex constructs -->
  <custom:element custom:attr="test">
    <![CDATA[
      Some literal data with <tags> and &entities; inside CDATA.
    ]]>
  </custom:element>
  <?another-pi data?>
</doc>
```

  <?xml-stylesheet href="sheet.css" type="text/css"?>
]>
<dataset xmlns="http://xml.org/dataset" xmlns:meta="http://xml.org/meta">
  <!-- Comment detailing the dataset structure -->
  <meta:info>
    <?meta-pi action="load"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Metadata CDATA block with special chars: <>&"'
    ]]>
  </meta:info>
  <item>&e2;</item>
</dataset>

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE configuration [
  <!ELEMENT configuration (setting*)>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext_param SYSTEM "http://localhost/nonexistent.dtd">
  <!ENTITY secret "TopSecretValue">
  <?config-loader engine="fast"?>
  <!-- Configuration comment block -->
]>
<configuration xmlns:cfg="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/cfg/" cfg:version="2.0">
  <!-- Inline processing instruction -->
  <?cfg-action debug="true"?>
  <cfg:setting name="mode">
    <![CDATA[
      Mode is set to <production> with &secret; fallback.
    ]]>
  </cfg:setting>
</configuration>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root-node [
  <!ELEMENT root-node (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent-a "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY ent-b "Beta &ent-a;">
  <!ENTITY ent-c "Gamma &ent-b;">
  <?pi-test key="value"?>
  <!-- Comment block explaining entity cascade -->
]>
<root-node xmlns="http://example.com/base" xmlns:p1="http://example.com/p1">
  <?p1-processor cmd="init"?>
  <!-- Comment inside root -->
  <p1:child>
    <![CDATA[
      Data payload with CDATA section and entities: &ent-c;
    ]]>
  </p1:child>
</root-node>
